purpose: Teach: 三宮/松平/トゥ/吉井/岩本/半田/栗山/入江

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、神戸三宮の支店を新規開設しろ
lines.en: We're opening a new branch in Sannomiya, Kobe. Get it started.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive opening. Low even pitch, zero hesitation — an order, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。徳川松平家ゆかりの記念商品を企画します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll plan a line of commemorative goods tied to the Tokugawa-Matsudaira family.
lines.style: Prompt, efficient acknowledgment. Crisp note-taking rhythm, a touch of fatigue underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、英語表記のトゥ、つまり「to」の使い方を社内で統一しろ
lines.en: And unify how we write the English 'tu' — the word 'to' — across the whole company.
lines.style: Measured and precise, slowing deliberately to spell out the detail. Mild impatience held in check.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外取引先の吉井氏との会合を設定します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll set up the meeting with Mr. Yoshii from our overseas partner.
lines.style: Brisk confirmation at pen-on-paper pace. Even tone, quietly competent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、顧問の岩本様にご助言を仰げ
lines.en: Go to our advisor, Mr. Iwamoto, and seek his guidance.
lines.style: Even, deliberate instruction with respectful weight resting on the advisor's name.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製造現場の半田、つまり半田作業の安全教育を強化します
lines.en: Yes, sir. On the factory floor — the soldering, I mean the solder work — I'll strengthen the safety training.
lines.style: Steady report with a small self-correcting stumble, recovering smoothly into the commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、栗山顧問の経営アドバイスを採用しろ
lines.en: We're adopting Advisor Kuriyama's management recommendations. See it through.
lines.style: Short and final, no room for debate. Volume flat, authority carried entirely in the pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海辺の入江、つまり入江沿いのリゾート開発を進めます
lines.en: Yes, sir. The seaside cove — the stretch along the inlet — I'll push the resort development forward there.
lines.style: Wrapping-up energy, slightly warmer close. A small exhale of relief as the list ends.
